# Alarm Fatigue in Security Monitoring: Causes, Costs, and How AI Fixes It
## Why alarm fatigue is the defining operational crisis in monitoring centers
Industry research from [The Monitoring Association](https://tma.us/the-impact-of-false-alarms/) and Central Station Alarm Association data consistently shows that **90–99% of alarms received by monitoring centers are false or non-actionable**.

## What good looks like: benchmarks for post-fatigue monitoring operations
- **False alarm rate below 5%** of total incoming alerts
